title: 第11章 恩怨
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
“今天是个好日子，心想滴事儿都能成～”

    集市上，林峰哼着跑调的小曲，脚步轻快地穿梭在摊位之间，脸上的笑意藏都藏不住。

    往常他买东西，那可是石铁城出了名的“砍三刀”。

    不管摊主开什么价，先砍三分之一再说，有时甚至能把摊主说的哑口无言，最后还得主动让价。

    可今天，他连价都不还，摊主说多少就给多少，甚至有摊主找零慢了，他直接摆手不要了。

    这反常的举动，让周围的摊主都愣住了。

    “老林啊，最近家里发生什么事了？是不是身体有什么问题啊？”

    “去去去，你身体才有问题！老子可是御卡师，当年曾一刀砍死一头熔岩虎，身体好着呢！”林峰笑着拍了拍胸脯，语气里满是自豪。

    旁边卖水果的张叔也凑过来，压低声音。

    “那就是林奇那孩子的事喽？我听说他觉醒了张废卡，你也别太往心里去。那孩子从小就聪明，脑子活络，就算不当御卡师，以后做生意当个小地主也挺好。”

    “哈哈哈，我儿子的确打小就聪明，随我。”

    林峰笑得更欢了，顺手从张叔的摊位上拿起一颗苹果，擦都不擦就咬了一口。

    “不过你可别小瞧我儿子，他可比我厉害多了！”

    就在这时，一道阴阳怪气的声音突然响起，打破了热闹的氛围。

    “你儿子？”

    “呵呵，你连老婆都没有，谁给你生的儿子？难道是隔壁老王他老婆？”

    “那你儿子不就是个杂种嘛。”

    林峰猛的转身，一脸阴沉的盯着面前的男人。

    “雷德！”

    “你他妈的敢再说一句？”

    四星御卡师的气势骤然爆发，周遭的人群瞬间四散而逃，摊主们也连忙收摊，生怕被波及。

    “呵呵，我说的不对吗？”

    雷德双手抱胸，脸上的嘲讽更浓了。

    “你那个所谓的儿子，觉醒了废卡，还不是个废物？跟你一样，一辈子没出息！”

    “老子一刀砍了你！”

    林峰再也忍不住，一把扔下手里的菜篮子。

    绿色的卡牌瞬间出现在掌心，光芒一闪，一把长刀出现在他手中。

    “林峰，你真以为自己还是以前那个天才？”

    雷德嗤笑一声，眼神里满是不屑。

    “为了照顾那个来路不明的小杂种，你十五年都没怎么修炼了吧？源力早就停滞不前了！我真为莉莉感到不值，当年怎么会看上你这种没出息的人！”

    雷德一步踏出，身上爆发出比林峰更强大的气势。光芒闪过，一把银色的长枪握在手中，枪尖泛着寒芒。

    “五星御卡师。”

    有人惊呼出声，“雷德竟然突破五星了！怪不得这么嚣张！”

    “五星御卡师能多开辟一个卡槽，林峰只有四星，这下可惨了！” 周围的人纷纷议论，看向林峰的眼神都充满了担忧。

    林峰眼神微眯，一脸不善的盯着雷德。

    “原来如此，刚突破五星就忍不住来找我麻烦了。看来那张新卡给了你很大底气。”
content_en:
"Today is a good day. Everything you dream of can come true~"

At the market, Lin Feng hummed an off-key ditty and walked briskly between stalls, unable to hide the smile on his face.

Usually when he buys things, it's Shi Tiecheng's famous "three cuts".

No matter what price the stall owner offers, he will cut off one-third of the price first. Sometimes the stall owner will be speechless, and he will have to take the initiative to give up the price in the end.

But today, he didn't even pay back the price. He gave the stall owner as much as he asked. Some stall owners were even slow to give change, so he simply waved it away.

This unusual behavior made the surrounding stall owners stunned.

"Old Lin, what happened at home recently? Is there something wrong with your health?"

"Go, go, it's your health that's the problem! I'm a card master. I once killed a lava tiger with one sword. I'm in good health!" Lin Feng smiled and patted his chest, his tone full of pride.

Uncle Zhang, the fruit seller next to him, also came over and lowered his voice.

"Is that what happened to Lynch's kid? I heard that he awakened a useless card, so don't take it too seriously. That kid has been smart and quick-witted since he was a child. Even if he is not a card master, he will be a small landowner in business in the future."

"Hahaha, my son has indeed been smart since he was a child. Follow me."

Lin Feng smiled even more happily, picked up an apple from Uncle Zhang's stall, and took a bite without wiping it off.

"But don't underestimate my son, he is much better than me!"

At this moment, a strange voice suddenly sounded, breaking the lively atmosphere.

"Your son?"

"Haha, you don't even have a wife, who gave birth to your son? Is it the wife of Mr. Wang next door?"

"Then your son is just a bastard."

Lin Feng turned around suddenly and stared at the man in front of him with a gloomy expression.

"Red!"

"How dare you fucking say another word?"

The four-star card master's momentum suddenly exploded, and the crowd around him fled in all directions. The stall owners also quickly closed their stalls for fear of being affected.

"Haha, am I right?"

Reid crossed his arms, the sarcasm on his face getting thicker.

"Your so-called son, after awakening the waste card, is he not a waste? Just like you, he will never achieve anything in his life!"

"I'll chop you with a knife!"

Lin Feng couldn't bear it anymore and threw down the vegetable basket in his hand.

A green card instantly appeared in his palm, and with a flash of light, a long knife appeared in his hand.

"Lin Feng, do you really think you are still the genius you were before?"

Red sneered, his eyes full of disdain.

"In order to take care of that little bastard of unknown origin, you haven't practiced much for fifteen years, right? The source of power has stagnated a long time ago! I really feel worthless for Lily. How could I have taken a fancy to a worthless person like you back then!"

Reid took a step forward, and his body erupted with an aura even more powerful than Lin Feng's.Light flashed, and a silver spear was held in his hand, the tip of the spear glowing with cold light.

"Five-star card master."

Someone exclaimed, "Red has broken through to five stars! No wonder he is so arrogant!"

"A five-star card master can open up one more card slot, but Lin Feng only has four stars. This is terrible!" People around him were talking about it, and their eyes looking at Lin Feng were full of worry.

Lin Feng narrowed his eyes slightly and stared at Reid with an unkind expression.

"I see, you just broke through to five stars and you couldn't help but come to trouble me. It seems that the new card gave you a lot of confidence."
